Real Speech Recorder

Records real (non-TTS) speech for backend/tests/fixtures/real_audio/ and frontend/e2e/fixtures/real-speech.wav — see run_real_audio_report.py and frontend/e2e/README.md. Pick a prompt on the left, record it, listen back, then save. Output is already the exact format the pipeline expects (mono 16-bit PCM WAV, 16000Hz) — no ffmpeg conversion needed.

No folder access yet. Click Grant repo access below and select the repo root folder (boostlingo_v2) — recordings save directly into place and the manifest updates itself. Without it, you can still record and download each file manually.
